about: s14/load (D-354): the baked world's units. A unit's source hash covers its entry modules, every module they import under src/ (tools/bake_world/srchash.mjs), and its data inputs; a change to any of them makes its cache entry stale and the page builds it live. Bump version to invalidate by hand.

impostors.keyed: the held jar and sack geometry hashed into the key at load

mudface.keyed: the parts (partsKey) hashed into the key; each face by the hash of its input geometry and gain
